variable: Labour income: compensation of employees (D.1), share of gross primary income
definition: Wages and salaries D.11 plus employers' social contributions D.12, S.14, before tax
target_cell_dimension: aggregate only; no wealth-band or stage split held
uncertainty_caveats: D.12 is not cash income to the household in the year; includes employer pension contributions. No cell dimension.
open_question_or_data_request: By wealth band and stage: needs a household survey link (WAS/FRS/LCF), not held

variable: Self-employment and housing services: gross operating surplus plus mixed income (B.2g+B.3g), share of B.5g
definition: Includes imputed rent of owner-occupiers and landlords' operating surplus (B.2g), self-employed mixed income (B.3g)
accounting_location: Y_L/Y_P boundary; housing services in B.2g not D.45
uncertainty_caveats: B.2g and B.3g cannot be separated into labour and capital return here; gross of CFC
proposed_ruling: further data required (split of B.2g into imputed rent and lettings)
open_question_or_data_request: ONS split of B.2g by dwelling services versus other; not held

variable: Transfer income: social benefits in cash (D.62) share of disposable income
definition: State pension and social security cash D.621, other social insurance D.622 (includes private pension benefits), social assistance D.623
target_cell_dimension: aggregate only; stage (retired) is the intended dimension
uncertainty_caveats: D.622 mixes private pension benefits with other insurance; no split by retired status
open_question_or_data_request: Benefit income by stage and band: needs FRS/WAS

variable: Taxes on income and wealth (D.5), share of gross primary income
definition: Current taxes on income and wealth paid by households (T_C), excluding WDT
uncertainty_caveats: D.5 includes council tax; D.61 contributions are separate

variable: Gross disposable income B.6g
definition: Balance of primary incomes plus social benefits and other current transfers received, less current taxes, net social contributions and other transfers paid; excludes social transfers in kind (D.63)
uncertainty_caveats: UKEA and QSA vintages differ by up to GBP 1m on identical years; not spliced

variable: Household final consumption (P.31) as a share of B.6g
definition: Individual consumption expenditure, current prices; not net depletion
uncertainty_caveats: Consumption share of income, not of wealth. No consumption by wealth band here
relation_to_existing_row: does not support I-D14c as evidence
open_question_or_data_request: Consumption by wealth band: LCF/WAS link; not held

variable: Saving ratio, published
definition: B.8g/(B.6g+D.8), households; published DG5H
uncertainty_caveats: Includes pension accrual (D.8). Gross of CFC

variable: Non-pension saving: B.8g - D.8 (the part of the ratio not pension accrual)
definition: Derived by the 097r identity; ONS publishes the split as JS8S (contribution to the ratio)
calculation_and_script: B8g-D8; derive_ons_flows.py (QSA1 tolerance 0.101pp, three terms at 1dp)
uncertainty_caveats: Negative in some years. Gross of CFC. Saving on the income side only (Scenario B)
intended_use: validation (aggregate); calibration only with a labelled scenario by cell
relation_to_existing_row: supersedes nothing; cross-checks I-W3a to I-W3d aggregates
open_question_or_data_request: Non-pension saving by wealth band and stage: unset, see data requests

variable: Cash-basis saving ratio (CSJ8)
definition: ONS alternative that excludes the pension net-equity adjustment and uses cash contributions and benefits
uncertainty_caveats: Different definition from DGD8; report difference, do not average
proposed_ruling: ready for implementation (as a reported alternative)

variable: Pension accrual: adjustment for change in pension entitlements D.8
definition: Net equity change in funded and unfunded pension schemes credited to households; counts as saving
target_cell_dimension: aggregate; accumulation vs decumulation stage unset
value_or_range: share of B.6g 2024: 4.8%; 1998-2025 min/median/max 3.0/7.3/9.7%; of open net worth 2024: 0.8%; 1998-2025 min/median/max 0.4/1.2/1.8%
uncertainty_caveats: Valuation basis: national-accounts net equity (ONS), not WAS Round 8 SCAPE. The difference is not quantified here. Not the Resolution Foundation basis
intended_use: calibration (aggregate pension flow) with named basis
open_question_or_data_request: Reconcile ONS pension entitlements (AF.6 stock) to WAS pension wealth totals: data request DR-01

variable: Pension contributions (employee and employer)
definition: D.611 employers' actual, D.613 households' actual, D.612 imputed, D.614 supplements, D.61SC charges
source_reference: L8NL, MA4A, L8PT, L8Q9, M92I, HADI
value_or_range: levels in derived_ons_flows.csv only; no pension-only series
uncertainty_caveats: Valuation basis: ONS national-accounts flow series (not WAS SCAPE, not Resolution Foundation). D.611 and D.613 mix NIC and pension contributions; D.614 equals D.442 (pension income attributed and returned)
open_question_or_data_request: DR-02: split D.611/D.613 into pension and NIC

variable: Pension investment return
definition: Return on pension wealth, valuation basis named
accounting_location: r on pension wealth; D.442 and B.103 AF.6
source_reference: D.442 (KZK9); B.103 AF.6 (N4EV); pension stock by instrument not held
uncertainty_caveats: Valuation basis: ONS national-accounts flow series (not WAS SCAPE, not Resolution Foundation). A rate needs the AF.6 stock, which is not held. B.103 AF.6 swings with actuarial discount rates (218bn in 2019, -218bn in 2024): a valuation change, not an asset return

variable: Pension withdrawal and decumulation
definition: Benefits paid from funded and unfunded schemes (D.622 other social insurance benefits)
uncertainty_caveats: Valuation basis: ONS national-accounts flow series (not WAS SCAPE, not Resolution Foundation). D.622 includes non-pension insurance benefits; lump sums and annuity purchases not separated
open_question_or_data_request: DR-03: D.622 split by scheme type and age group

variable: Pension valuation basis register
definition: ONS national-accounts net equity (D.8, AF.6); WAS Round 8 SCAPE-method DB wealth (pack wealth base); Resolution Foundation basis (excludes DB, validation context only)
accounting_location: basis label on every pension row
uncertainty_caveats: The three bases are not reconciled here. Never mix. BF-02 and AB-01 use the RF basis

variable: Retained cash property income (D.4 received excluding D.441 and D.442), share of B.6g
definition: Interest, distributed income, CIS and rent on land received by households, after removing income attributed to insurance and pension holders
target_cell_dimension: aggregate; retained fraction by band unset
uncertainty_caveats: Includes sheltered income; not net of interest paid (D.4 paid is GBP 93bn in 2024); not a yield on wealth
open_question_or_data_request: Retained share by band: unset; HMRC 3.7 is by total income, not wealth

variable: HMRC taxable interest and dividends against ONS D.41 and D.42
definition: Table 3.7, 2023-24, UK taxpayers, SPI; bank interest and dividends
source_reference: Table 3.7 columns for interest and dividends
value_or_range: interest 0.19 and dividends 0.52 of ONS 2024 (tax-year 2023-24 against calendar 2024)
uncertainty_caveats: Taxpayer taxable income only; ISA, pension and non-taxpayer income excluded; tax year not calendar year
proposed_ruling: ready for implementation (as a coverage check)

variable: Housing services yield cross-check
definition: ONS B.2g over opening dwellings plus land (S.14) set against JST housing rental return (net rent/price)
uncertainty_caveats: ONS is gross of CFC and includes non-dwelling operating surplus; JST is net rent over a country housing stock. Definitions differ; not spliced
open_question_or_data_request: DR-04: ONS CFC on dwellings and B.2g split

variable: Cash yield, portfolio, real (JST market portfolio, arithmetic mean of annual components)
definition: Real cash-yield (or holding-gain) contribution of the JST capital total return, weights recovered from composite returns (100r)
target_cell_dimension: market portfolio; not household or band
uncertainty_caveats: Bond yield is a proxy (coupon or yield to maturity); bill gain is zero by convention; housing yield includes imputed rent; arithmetic only, the geometric I-D1a2 does not split additively; ends 2019; 1940-46 absent
intended_use: calibration with a scenario range across the period means; not household retained income

variable: Holding gain, portfolio, real (JST market portfolio, arithmetic mean of annual components)
definition: Real cash-yield (or holding-gain) contribution of the JST capital total return, weights recovered from composite returns (100r)
target_cell_dimension: market portfolio; not household or band
uncertainty_caveats: Bond yield is a proxy (coupon or yield to maturity); bill gain is zero by convention; housing yield includes imputed rent; arithmetic only, the geometric I-D1a2 does not split additively; ends 2019; 1940-46 absent
intended_use: calibration with a scenario range across the period means; not household retained income

variable: Total return, real, arithmetic (JST)
definition: Sum of F-17 and F-18
uncertainty_caveats: As F-17
proposed_ruling: ready for implementation (already in the register)

variable: Cash yield and gain by asset class (real)
definition: Equity, housing, bond, bill yield and gain, JST
value_or_range: 1896-2019 mean real yield equity 4.352, housing 3.758, bond 5.270, bill 4.393 (% per year)
uncertainty_caveats: Bond and bill yields are proxies; band holdings by asset class belong to 102r

variable: Revaluation of nominal liabilities (real erosion)
definition: Opening financial liabilities x pi/(1+pi), pi from the household expenditure deflator
value_or_range: as share of opening net worth 2024: 0.58%; 1998-2025 min/median/max -0.11/0.33/1.44%
uncertainty_caveats: Loans are valued at par in B.103, so this is a real-terms identity, not a recorded flow. NIWJ mixes mortgages, other loans and payables
open_question_or_data_request: Liabilities by band and debt type: 102r

variable: Holding gains on financial assets (B.103) and other volume changes (B.102)
definition: Revaluation account, S.14 plus S.15, financial only
value_or_range: B.103 2024: GBP -168.1bn; of which equity 58bn, pension and insurance -218bn
uncertainty_caveats: Financial assets only. Non-financial (housing) revaluation not held. S.14+S.15 label
proposed_ruling: ready for implementation (as a reported series)

variable: Net-worth residual O
definition: dNW(E45V) - B.101g - B.102 - B.103; absorbs CFC, non-financial revaluation, S.15 mismatch and statistical discrepancy
uncertainty_caveats: Reported, never absorbed into S. Not a parameter
proposed_ruling: ready for implementation (as a reported residual)

variable: Aggregate saving over opening net worth (gross of CFC)
definition: B.8g/E45V[t-1], and non-pension (B.8g-D.8)/E45V[t-1]; no CFC series held
uncertainty_caveats: Gross of CFC so an upper bound for net saving. The kernel c is not consumption: c=(y-s)/(1+r); see 093r
relation_to_existing_row: context for I-D14c (093r computes c); does not test it or select a replacement

variable: Legacy I-D14c: 3.5% consumption share of net worth
definition: v2 `c` default (valgen D16); a framing value, not an estimate
value_or_range: 3.5 as legacy comparator only (range 0.5 to 5 in the register)
uncertainty_caveats: Not UK evidence. Never used as support for a band rate
relation_to_existing_row: legacy; 093r reports an aggregate arithmetic range for c of 0.4 to 3.0%; this block adds no value

variable: Existing row I-D1a (arithmetic mean real total return 4.74)
definition: JST UK arithmetic mean
classification: Observed (source JST); proxy for household return
uncertainty_caveats: As F-19

variable: Existing row I-D1a2 (geometric 4.42)
definition: Geometric mean real return
uncertainty_caveats: Geometric means do not split into yield and gain additively; the split rows are arithmetic
relation_to_existing_row: reclassifies the split rows as arithmetic-only

variable: Audit I-W1c: UK financial return gap, top decile minus bottom deciles (1.8 to 2.0 pp)
definition: Portfolio-composition-implied mean financial return, WAS 2016-18, Bangham and Leslie 2020 Fig 7, financial wealth only
source_reference: inputs.md I-W1c; AB-05 (shares in zero-return assets, 71% to 17% by decile, Advani-Bangham-Leslie)
uncertainty_caveats: Built from composition, not observed returns; excludes housing and pensions; source figure not held; direction agrees with AB-05 and the gap is described as probably larger
proposed_ruling: remain unset (as calibration); keep as validation
relation_to_existing_row: supports the direction; reclassify from judgement to proxy; the numeric gap is not verifiable from held files
open_question_or_data_request: Fagereng-style UK return by rank is not available

variable: Audit I-W3a: net active saving rate by wealth, 6 to 8% of disposable income
definition: Norway, 2005-2015, Fagereng et al.; read from a figure
uncertainty_caveats: Foreign population and income concept; figure reading. For scale only (a different concept, not a test): UK non-pension saving, contribution to the ratio of B.6g+D.8, 2024: 4.9pp; 1998-2025 min/median/max -2.6/1.0/13.5pp
relation_to_existing_row: does not support as a UK value; UK evidence is aggregate or by income (F-33)
open_question_or_data_request: UK saving by wealth band: not available in held data

variable: Audit I-W3b: gross saving rate top 1% (about 35%)
definition: Norway 2005-2015, includes unrealised capital gains
uncertainty_caveats: Gross rate includes holding gains; not comparable with the household saving ratio (which excludes holding gains) or with F-08
relation_to_existing_row: contradicts use as a saving rate: it is gross of holding gains, so mixes S and CG

variable: Audit I-W3c: net saving share of the change in family financial wealth (7 to 24%)
definition: GB financial wealth, WAS, Bangham and Leslie 2020 Fig 6; AB-01 gives passive shares 76 to 93%
uncertainty_caveats: Financial wealth only; excludes pensions and housing; RF-style counterfactual method
relation_to_existing_row: supports (AB-01 passive 76 to 93% implies saving 7 to 24%)

variable: Audit I-W3d: active saving about 40% of total wealth gain, 2018-20 to 2020-22
definition: Before the fall (RF basis excludes DB pensions); BF-02 gives 40% active in the latest period
uncertainty_caveats: Two-year window including pandemic saving; RF basis, not the WDT pension basis
relation_to_existing_row: supports (BF-02 latest-period active 40%); not a basis for a central rate
open_question_or_data_request: RF basis versus WDT basis: DR-01

variable: Saving by lifetime income and education (direction)
definition: LCFS active saving; ELSA wealth to lifetime earnings (Bozio and others 2013)
target_cell_dimension: income quintile, education; not wealth band
value_or_range: direction only; gap of the order of 4 points of income (median, highest education against compulsory-only), a nearest UK bound, not a calibration
uncertainty_caveats: Ranks by income or education, not wealth; excludes holding gains; the authors say it does not speak to the very wealthy
relation_to_existing_row: supports a direction for working-saver cells; no row exists
open_question_or_data_request: Saving by wealth band: further data required

variable: Passive and active share of wealth change (validation moments)
definition: BF-02 passive 53% since 2010-12 (60% in 2018-20 to 2020-22); AB-01 passive 76 to 93% financial wealth
uncertainty_caveats: Resolution Foundation basis excludes DB pensions; validation context only; never mixed with the ONS or SCAPE basis

variable: NMG survey saving and debt-service variables
definition: be2afree_c (share of household income put aside as cash savings), soa1 (change in saving excluding pension), qbe02 (left-over income change), be08free_c (mortgage instalment), be07free_c (mortgage balance), qincomev2 (income band), cv11/BOE65afree_c (savings balance)
target_cell_dimension: household, income band; no wealth band except through savings balances
uncertainty_caveats: Microdata and the workbook are not held (097r: reachable but not parseable); only the variable inventory is held; wording changed across waves
open_question_or_data_request: DR-06: NMG 2011-2026 workbook contents (values), exact wave coverage per variable
